item.g:description: A Surrey-flavoured blend of reds and browns with darker mottling worked across each face. Nothing about it shouts, which is the point: it gives an elevation depth and then gets out of the way of the windows, doors and detailing. A safe specification across whole houses as readily as single extensions. Made by Wienerberger. 65mm, pack of 400.

item.g:title: Wienerberger Oatmeal Blend 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 504)
item.g:description: Soft neutral tones through pale oatmeal and light buff, blended so the wall keeps quiet depth without pattern. It is a restrained, undemanding brick that sits comfortably beside render, timber, stone and glazing on contemporary and traditional work alike. A good candidate where the brickwork needs to recede and let another material take the lead. Made by Wienerberger. 65mm, pack of 504.

item.g:title: Wienerberger Reclaimed Shire Sovereign Stock 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 430)
item.g:description: Built to look salvaged from a country wall that came down decades ago: worn reds and browns, darker weathered bricks scattered through, and the creased irregular face of traditional stock production. All the character of genuine reclaims, with sizes that actually match and stock you can rely on turning up. Made by Wienerberger. 65mm, pack of 430.

item.g:title: Wienerberger Tabasco Red Multi 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 430)
item.g:description: A hot, saturated red with darker tones running through it, and the name is not modest about it. This is a brick for elevations meant to carry colour, holding its intensity in flat overcast light where softer reds tend to go grey. Used sparingly, as a feature panel or banding, it earns its keep more easily than across four full elevations. Made by Wienerberger. 65mm, pack of 430.

item.g:title: Wienerberger Autumn Russet Sovereign Stock 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 430)
item.g:description: Russet and amber tones over the creased, softened face of a stock brick, giving both the colour of autumn and the irregularity of traditional stock production. The two together produce a wall that looks like it has been standing a while, which is exactly what period extensions and garden walls tend to need. Made by Wienerberger. 65mm, pack of 430.

item.g:title: Wienerberger Kingsley Multi 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 400)
item.g:description: Reds and browns blended with lighter and darker bricks throughout, giving a wall genuine movement without ever tipping into busy. It is an everyday multi in the best sense, dependable enough for a full development and characterful enough for a single rear extension. Worth ordering a sample if you are matching against something existing, since the mid-range tones can read warmer or cooler depending on what sits beside them. Made by Wienerberger. 65mm, pack of 400.

item.g:title: Wienerberger Draycott Red Multi 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 504)
item.g:description: Warm reds with browns and darker mottling worked across each face, giving depth that holds up over large areas of walling. An unfussy, reliable multi that neither demands special treatment nor limits what you put next to it. Sensible for a full development, a rear extension or a boundary wall without needing to think too hard about it. Made by Wienerberger. 65mm, pack of 504.

item.g:title: Wienerberger Clent Russet Mixture 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 430)
item.g:description: Russet reds warmed with browns and softer orange, drawn from the colouring of the Worcestershire hills it takes its name from. The mixture reads rich without going dark, and lifts noticeably in low morning and evening light. Rural extensions and village infill are its natural home, though it holds up perfectly well on a suburban semi. Made by Wienerberger. 65mm, pack of 430.

item.g:title: Wienerberger Cedarwood Multi 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 400)
item.g:description: Warm browns shot through with red and softer tan tones, named for the timber it echoes. Brown sits in useful territory between the neutrality of grey and the commitment of red, and this one keeps enough variation across each face to stop a long elevation flattening out. Works particularly hard alongside timber cladding and stone. Made by Wienerberger. 65mm, pack of 400.

item.g:title: Wienerberger Bourneville Buff Blend 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 504)
item.g:description: Pale sandy buffs blended with cream and light brown, bright enough to lift an elevation without the flatness of a single uniform colour. Buff sits easily with render, stone and timber, so it turns up on contemporary schemes as often as traditional ones. Order a sample and look at it in overcast light as well as sun, since pale bricks shift character more than dark ones between the two. Made by Wienerberger. 65mm, pack of 504.

item.g:title: Wienerberger Warm Golden Buff 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 500)
item.g:description: Buff with the warmth turned up, sitting in honey and gold territory rather than plain sand. The colour lifts strongly in low sun and stays pleasant in flat light, which is not something every pale brick manages. Comfortable beside stone, render and timber on both traditional and contemporary work. Made by Wienerberger. 65mm, pack of 500.

item.g:title: Wienerberger Ashington Red Multi 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 500)
item.g:description: Warm reds worked through with browns and darker mottling, carrying the solid, unpretentious character of northern brickwork. It does the job across a full elevation without asking for attention, and takes grey or buff mortar equally well. A practical choice for housing, extensions and boundary walls where reliability matters more than making a statement. Made by Wienerberger. 65mm, pack of 500.

item.g:title: Wienerberger Harvest Buff Multi 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 500)
item.g:description: Sandy buffs warmed with cream and light brown, named for the field colours it borrows. Bright enough to open up an elevation, varied enough to avoid the flatness that catches out plain pale bricks. Comfortable beside render, stone and timber. A dark mortar against it makes a strong graphic wall, which suits contemporary work particularly well. Made by Wienerberger. 65mm, pack of 500.

item.g:title: Wienerberger Gilt Red Multi 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 500)
item.g:description: Warm reds lifted with golden highlights and softer brown tones, giving more life than a conventional red multi manages. The gilt quality shows most in raking light, when the highlights catch and the wall gains a subtle glow. Sensible for housing and extensions where a plain red would feel flat but a strong multi would be too much. Made by Wienerberger. 65mm, pack of 500.

item.g:title: Wienerberger Waresley Orange 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 500)
item.g:description: Warm terracotta orange with gentle variation, sunnier than a conventional red without tipping into anything garish. It comes alive on west-facing walls in the late afternoon, and holds its warmth better than most oranges in overcast conditions. Good for extensions, garden walls and infill where the surrounding brickwork already leans orange. Made by Wienerberger. 65mm, pack of 500.

item.g:title: Wienerberger Witton Multi 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 500)
item.g:description: Reds and browns mixed with softer neutral tones, producing a wall with balanced movement that works at any scale. An easy blend to build with, adding depth to an elevation without dictating what happens around it. Fine across a whole house, and equally at home on a single extension or a run of garden wall. Made by Wienerberger. 65mm, pack of 500.

item.g:title: Wienerberger Gilt Smoked Orange Multi 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 500)
item.g:description: The orange of the Gilt family with smoked, darkened patches laid over it, adding age and weight. The smoking varies from brick to brick, so the wall gains the uneven darkening of brickwork that has stood in a town for a few decades. Useful where new brickwork has to sit beside something genuinely old without looking freshly delivered. Made by Wienerberger. 65mm, pack of 500.

item.g:title: Wienerberger Maplehurst Light Multi 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 500)
item.g:description: The lighter end of the multi range, mixing soft reds and buffs with paler bricks throughout. It brightens an elevation while keeping the varied quality of a traditional wall, which is a useful combination on extensions to lighter period brickwork. Worth seeing a laid panel rather than judging from a single brick, since light multis change character noticeably at scale. Made by Wienerberger. 65mm, pack of 500.

item.g:title: Wienerberger Trinity Cream Gilt 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 500)
item.g:description: Soft cream lifted by the golden highlights the Gilt range is built around. The effect is delicate rather than showy, giving a pale wall subtle warmth and depth in raking light where a flat cream would simply look flat. Suits contemporary schemes and areas where stone or render sets the tone rather than red brick. Made by Wienerberger. 65mm, pack of 500.

item.g:title: Wienerberger London Stock 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 500)
item.g:description: The brick that built the capital. Soft yellow-to-buff bodies, smoky creased faces, and tone shifting from one brick to the next so a finished wall reads weathered rather than flat. Made in both the standard metric height and a 68mm imperial for the Georgian and Victorian coursing it is usually asked to match. Made by Wienerberger. 65mm, pack of 500.

item.g:title: Wienerberger Gilt Yellow 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 500)
item.g:description: A warm golden yellow with the gilt highlights the range is built around, cleaner and more consistent than the multi version. Pair it with an off-white mortar and the warmth carries; grey will cool it more than you might expect. Made by Wienerberger. 65mm, pack of 500.

item.g:title: Wienerberger Gilt Yellow Multi 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 500)
item.g:description: Golden yellows blended with buff and softer brown, the gilt highlights lifting the whole across each face. item.g:title: Wienerberger Mulberry Red 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 500)

item.g:title: Wienerberger Durham Red Multi 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 500)

item.g:title: Wienerberger Chartham Multi 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 500)
item.g:description: A Kentish blend of reds and browns softened with neutral tones, carrying the gentle variation of established brickwork rather than the strong contrast of a heavy multi. item.g:title: Wienerberger Capelwick Multi 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 500)
item.g:description: Reds and browns with darker mottling worked across each face, giving a wall depth that holds up over a long run of brickwork. It is an unshowy blend, the sort specified when the elevation needs interest but not a focal point. Fine across a whole house or a single rear extension. Made by Wienerberger. 65mm, pack of 500.

item.g:title: Wienerberger Gilt Orange Multi 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 500)
item.g:description: Warm orange tones with gilt highlights and softer browns worked through, part of a family built around that golden quality. item.g:title: Wienerberger Tawny Buff 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 500)
item.g:description: Sandy buff pushed towards the warmer, tawnier end of the range, with soft movement across the face. item.g:title: Wienerberger Cinnabar Red Multi 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 500)
item.g:description: Named for the vivid mineral pigment, and the colouring lives up to it: strong warm reds with orange running through and darker tones for depth. Made by Wienerberger. 65mm, pack of 500.

item.g:title: Wienerberger Gilt Smoked Yellow Multi 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 500)

A soft lime-toned mortar reinforces the aged quality; a crisp grey works against it. Made by Wienerberger. 65mm, pack of 500.

item.g:title: Wienerberger Lingfield Red Multi 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 500)
item.g:description: Warm reds worked through with browns and the occasional darker brick, giving a wall real movement without heavy contrast. A dependable Surrey and Sussex multi, broad enough to hold interest across a full development and forgiving about mortar choice. Fine across a whole house, a rear extension or a long run of boundary wall without needing much thought. Made by Wienerberger. 65mm, pack of 500.

item.g:title: Wienerberger Sandalwood Yellow Multi 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 500)
item.g:description: Warm sandy yellows blended with light brown and softer neutral tones, part of the same family as the plain Sandalwood but with noticeably more going on across each face. Worth seeing both laid side by side before choosing, as the difference is more obvious in a wall than in the hand. Made by Wienerberger. 65mm, pack of 500.

item.g:title: Wienerberger Durham Claret 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 500)
item.g:description: A deep wine red with plum undertones, considerably more formal in character than an everyday facing red. The darker body holds its presence over large areas, which suits apartment schemes, urban housing and anywhere the palette is meant to feel considered. It also does good work as a darker banding course set against a lighter brick. Made by Wienerberger. 65mm, pack of 500.

item.g:title: Wienerberger Waresley Red 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 500)
item.g:description: A clean warm red with a faintly worked face and modest variation, even across a large elevation without going lifeless. There is nothing complicated about it, which is much of the appeal: it does the job on housing, extensions and boundary walls and lets the detailing round it do the talking. Made by Wienerberger. 65mm, pack of 500.

item.g:title: Wienerberger Winchester Multi 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 500)
item.g:description: Warm reds and browns blended with softer neutral tones, carrying the composed quality associated with Hampshire brickwork. Variation is present but restrained, which makes it easy to specify across a whole house without the wall becoming the loudest thing on the site. Equally comfortable on a new build, an extension or a run of garden wall. Made by Wienerberger. 65mm, pack of 500.

item.g:title: Forterra Lindum Cottage Red Multi 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 495)
item.g:description: Reds and browns blended over a softly irregular face, aimed at the cottage and village work its name suggests. Compare a sample against the existing wall in daylight, and check the coursing while you have the tape out. Made by Forterra. 65mm, pack of 495.

item.g:title: Wienerberger Olde Sussex Blend 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 500)
item.g:description: A broad mix of reds, browns and softer weathered tones over irregular faces, echoing the unplanned brickwork of Sussex farms and cottages. The spread between bricks is wide, so walls come out looking accumulated rather than specified. Cottage extensions, village infill and garden structures are where it earns its keep. Made by Wienerberger. 65mm, pack of 500.

item.g:title: Wienerberger Olde Cranleigh Multi 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 500)
item.g:description: Reds and browns blended over a softly irregular face, carrying the unforced variation of Surrey village brickwork. It builds up with genuine tonal movement, which suits cottage extensions and rural infill far better than anything uniform would. A soft lime mortar and a struck joint will get you closer to the period look than the brick alone. Made by Wienerberger. 65mm, pack of 500.

item.g:title: Wienerberger Olde Henfield Multi 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 500)
item.g:description: A Sussex blend running through warm reds and browns with a lightly weathered, irregular face. Suits extensions, garden walls and infill across the Weald, where the local stock has long since mellowed. Made by Wienerberger. 65mm, pack of 500.

item.g:title: Forterra Kimbolton Red Multi 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 495)
item.g:description: Warm reds worked through with browns and darker mottling, giving depth across a wall without heavy contrast. A safe specification for housing, extensions and boundary walls where dependability matters more than character. Made by Forterra. 65mm, pack of 495.

item.g:title: Wienerberger Warnham Red 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 500)
item.g:description: A mellow Sussex red with soft variation and a gently worked face, warm rather than hard-edged. item.g:title: Forterra Yorkshire Red Blend 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 504)
item.g:description: Warm reds and browns blended with the solid, hard-working character of northern brickwork. item.g:title: Wienerberger Olde Autumn Antique 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 500)

item.g:title: Wienerberger Olde Heritage Antique 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 500)
item.g:description: Darkened, patchy weathering over worn reds and browns, with an irregular face that reads as genuinely old rather than merely rustic. Expect it to look slightly fresher than the wall beside it for the first year or two; that gap closes on its own. Made by Wienerberger. 65mm, pack of 500.

item.g:title: Wienerberger Olde Horsham 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 500)
item.g:description: Warm reds and browns over a worn, softly irregular face, drawn from the brickwork of the Sussex town it takes its name from. Made by Forterra. 65mm, pack of 495.

item.g:title: Forterra Kirton Arden Red 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 495)
item.g:description: A warm mid red with gentle variation and a lightly worked face, unfussy and easy to build with. item.g:description: The Warnham body pushed into terracotta territory, warm and orange-leaning with soft variation across the face. item.g:title: Forterra Ashwell Yellow Multi 65mm Facing Bricks (Pack of 495)
item.g:description: Warm yellows blended with buff and softer brown tones, bright enough to lift a wall and varied enough to look established rather than newly delivered.
